chunks: I said to him: [What is the meaning of] the statement of God, Mighty and Majestic: 'This is Our Book that speaks against you with the truth'?
He said: So he said: Surely the Book has never spoken and will never speak, but the Messenger of God (may God's blessings be upon him and his family) — he is the speaker for the Book.
God, Mighty and Majestic, has [truly] said: 'This is Our Book that is spoken against you with the truth.'

He [the narrator] said: I said: May I be a sacrifice for you, we do not read it like this. He said: By God, this is how Gabriel descended with it upon Muhammad (may God's blessings be upon him and his family), but it is among what was altered from the Book of God.

key_terms.النَّاطِقُ بِالْكِتَابِ: The one who speaks for the Book — a title applied to the Prophet as the authoritative interpreter and living embodiment of the Quran
key_terms.حُرِّفَ: Was altered/distorted — referring to changes made to the Quran text; controversial theological claim in certain Shia traditions
key_terms.يُنْطَقُ: Is spoken (passive) — the original revealed form according to the Imam, distinguishing it from the active yanтиq (speaks)

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq say about Quran 45:29 and the Prophet as speaker of the Book?
ai.summary: Abu Baseer recounts asking Imam al-Sadiq (AS) about Quran 45:29, which in the standard recitation reads 'this is Our Book that speaks against you.' The Imam clarifies that the Book itself does not literally speak; rather, the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) is the one who speaks on behalf of the Book. The Imam then reveals that the original Quranic reading as brought by Gabriel used the passive form 'is spoken' (yuнтаq) rather than the active 'speaks' (yanтиq), and that this change represents one of the alterations made to the Quranic text. This hadith is part of a Shia tradition concerning the integrity of the Quran and the role of the Prophet and Imams as interpreters of the divine revelation.

he (a.s.) said: ‘Surely, the Book has never Spoken and will never Speak, but the Messenger (saww) of Allah (azwj), he (saww) is the speaker of the Book.
Allah (azwj) has Said: “[45:29] This (the Messenger (saww) of Allah (azwj) )is Our book that speaks against you with the truth”.

The narrator said, ‘I asked, ‘May I be sacrificed for you (a.s.), we do not read it as such’. He (a.s.) said: ‘By Allah (azwj), this is how Gabriel came down with it upon Muhammad (saww), but this is what was altered from the Book of Allah (azwj)’.
